convert_prx_checkpoint_to_diffusers: run the script to convert a PRX checkpoint to diffusers pipeline format with flux or dc-ae VAE
build_config_for_vae_type: build a PRX transformer config dictionary for a given VAE type like flux or dc-ae
create_parameter_mapping_for_depth: create a parameter name mapping from old PRX checkpoint keys to new diffusers attention module keys
convert_checkpoint_parameters: convert an old PRX checkpoint state dict to the new diffusers parameter naming format
create_transformer_from_checkpoint: create a PRXTransformer2DModel instance loaded from an old checkpoint file with automatic parameter conversion
